Baste the turkey with melted butter or oil every 30 minutes to keep it moist and promote even browning. **Timing and temperature:** To ensure the turkey is cooked to a safe internal temperature, use a meat thermometer to check the temperature in the thickest part of the breast and the innermost part of the thigh, avoiding any bones or fat.
